physics.criterion: Each dry solid material and the carrier fluid obey its own mass budget: current mass equals initial mass plus independently measured cumulative inflow minus outflow. Transfers between free, attached, and pore liquid do not create mass.
For each complete dry-solid material body, the linear momentum change equals the time-integrated external force plus applied external impulses.
The total actual solid-to-fluid and fluid-to-solid exchange forces cancel. This checks aggregate action-reaction balance, not pointwise traction accuracy or a zero total external force.
Resolved low-inertia pore liquid obeys q = -(K/mu)(grad(p)-rho*g) and d(phi*S)/dt + div(phi*S*v_s+q) = s, including transport by the swelling solid skeleton.
